name: PinPoint by Avalanche
changelog: 2.3.3 — Comment threads lead with the comment; status, effort, assignee and labels sit below the reply box. Drag any comment box by its header to move it off the element. Project owners can turn status, effort, assignee and labels off per project in the dashboard. 2.3.2 — Comment list filters fit on two rows again (the “This page only” switch was cut off). 2.3.1 — Find comments by device: mobile and tablet pins carry a badge, the comment list filters by device, and clicking a comment left at another width switches the preview to that device and opens it. 2.3.0 — Triage: a “Waiting on client” status, labels (bug, copy, design, content, photo, decision) and effort (quick, medium, large) on every item; exports open with a summary of what's waiting on the client vs quick wins vs bigger work; the AI assistant can triage items itself and the dashboard can email the client what needs their decision. 2.2.2 — Comments and replies can be just an image, no text required; saving waits for an in-progress upload. 2.2.1 — Cleaner comment popover: status and assignee are compact controls above the thread, Delete is back beside Mark resolved / Reopen, and the image button sits on the reply row. 2.2.0 — Feedback statuses (open, in progress, resolved, won't fix) and assignees; automatic screenshots and browser context on new comments; page approvals and Slack/ClickUp integrations for Agency plans; a hosted MCP server for Claude Code; new Free/Pro/Agency plans. 2.1.2 — PinPoint now lives at pinpoint.avalanchegr.com. 2.1.1 — The PinPoint logo. 2.1.0 — Avalanche Markup is now PinPoint. Pins find their element far more reliably after the page changes (new fingerprint matching plus live re-positioning when layout shifts). AI assistants can now reply to and resolve items from an export. 2.0.0 — Avalanche Markup 2.0: accounts and site ownership, the customer dashboard and plans, per-site bridge secrets, and a refreshed Avalanche look. After updating, add AVALANCHE_MARKUP_PROJECT_SECRET to wp-config.php — Settings → Avalanche Markup shows where to find it.
